outcome: Failure of conversion of epidural labor analgesia to cesarean delivery anesthesia
cohort: 180 term parturients undergoing emergency cesarean section after induction of epidural labor analgesia between September 2015 and May 2019
finding: Chorioamnionitis is associated with the failed conversion of epidural labor analgesia to cesarean delivery anesthesia.
mod_finding: This study focused on the association between chorioamnionitis and failed conversion of epidural labor analgesia to cesarean delivery anesthesia, not on different modes of delivery.
